WHO WE ARE

Printing Excellence Since Day One

AzeezgraphiX is a premium printing services studio based in Bolgatanga, Upper East Region, Ghana. With 8+ years of experience, we've delivered professional-grade design and print production work across northern Ghana.

We specialize in print that works — graphic design, large format print, vehicle branding, t-shirt print, embroidery/DTF/sublimation, and package print.

WHAT WE OFFER

Complete Printing Solutions

Flyer & Poster Design

Eye-catching designs for events, announcements, and promotions. Print-ready files optimized for perfect reproduction.

Banner & Billboard Design

Large-format designs that command attention. We design for real-world spaces and high-traffic zones.

Vehicle Wraps

Turn vehicles into mobile advertisements. Full-wrap or partial designs that maximize brand visibility.

Business Branding

Business cards, letterheads, and brand identity systems. Professional collateral that builds credibility.

Packaging Design

Product labels, cartons, and containers. Designs that appeal on shelves and tell your brand's story.

Uniforms & Apparel

Embroidery designs and screen-print layouts for uniforms, t-shirts, and branded apparel.
